question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Eliminate
solution:
The correct answer is option 4) i.e. 'Exclude.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given word:

 
 
 

 Word
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 Eliminate
 to remove or take away someone or something. (किसी को या किसी चीज़ को हटाना या दूर करना)
 
 
 
 
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the words given in the options:
 
 
 

 Word
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 Lighten
 to reduce the weight of something. (किसी चीज का वजन कम करना)
 
 

 Include
 to contain something as a part of something else. (किसी चीज़ को किसी और चीज़ के हिस्से के रूप में शामिल करना)
 
 

 Darken
 to become dark or darker in colour. (रंग गहरा या गहरा होना)
 
 

 Exclude
 to keep out or omit something or someone. (कुछ या किसी को बाहर रखना या छोड़ना)
 
 
 
 

 

 
• Clearly, the word 'Exclude' is closest in meaning to the given word 'Eliminate.'
 
• Therefore, the correct synonym of the given word is option 4.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__** 

 
• Let's look at the synonyms and antonyms for the given word 'Eliminate':

 
• Synonyms: cancel, defeat, disqualify, eradicate, erase, exclude.
 
• Antonyms: add, aid, allow, create, establish.
